reviews.text: We've now sent three dogs through their two-week program and keep coming back for a reason. Cosmo was our most recent and honestly this was the best experience yet. Ray has been our guy through all of it and he is the real deal. Any time we had a question he was on it, never felt like we were bothering him, and you could tell he actually cared about how Cosmo was doing and not just going through the motions. If you're on the fence, don't be. These people are the real thing.
My dog runs in and jumps on the stafff he loves it there so much

We trust this place so much with our babies! Another trip we were nervous to take because we are business owners and we never take trips together, but when we do, we bring our 2 youngest of our pack of 5 to PCOS! I email checking in and they respond with updates like, “the girls are eating well, playing well with others and taking advantage of the kiddie pool outside, having fun.” I pick them up and they are EXHAUSTED!! We don’t board our older pups for our own personal (health) reasons, but we know our littles are in the BEST HANDS with y’all! So, THANK YOU, THANK YOU!!

We had 2 of our 5 pups scheduled to go to another boarding place (one we’ve taken them to several times) BUT, we were turned away BECAUSE we got them their bordatella shot!! The other place said, NOPE, we can’t take them now, which should concern other pet owners who board at THAT place!

So, I called our vet who recommended PCOS and my ONLY hesitation was that we had never been there before and now, because we were in a situation (leaving the country the next day) we needed help.
Let me tell you, Ray, Pearla and Lillian were SO kind, understanding (as they require a pre visit assessment prior to boarding) and they explained that they would have to quarantine our two to assess their behavior etc. before introducing them to daycare side, which I respected and agreed with! Gotta keep everyone safe!

I checked in after we arrived in mexico (as anyone who knows me, knows I do while I’m out of town) and a couple other times (helicopter mom here) and got quick responses and updates on my pups, that they were doing great, had been great with the other pups in daycare and were eating and “doing their business.”

Just getting responses to my emails and/or calls put me at so much ease after the chaos that led us to PCOS! THANK YOU TO ALL OF YOU, SINCERELY!! We’ve found our new boarding place going forward! Our pups (Cali and Savannah) came home smelling so good after their baths, tired from playing and happy pups!

I’m definitely a worrier about my babies as they are MY BABIES! Even though I called/emailed, I appreciate the timely updates, patience and understanding I received from yall! We will be back!
